subject.title: feat(zalouser): recover accepted messages after local crashes

question: Should documented path/source Zalo Personal installs receive a narrowly scoped durable-ingress storage capability, or should that installation mode remain unable to use this reliability feature?
rationale: Current main deliberately limits plugin state to bundled and trusted official plugins, so choosing to extend durable storage to local installs is a trust-boundary decision rather than a mechanical test repair.

options.title: Add a scoped local ingress capability
options.body: Preserve the documented local-install path by exposing only the minimal durable queue capability needed for channel ingress, with an explicit trust and lifecycle contract.

options.title: Keep the current state boundary
options.body: Retain state access for bundled or trusted official installs only and explicitly change the Zalo Personal installation and durability contract before landing.

recommendation.title: Add a scoped local ingress capability
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented local-install path by exposing only the minimal durable queue capability needed for channel ingress, with an explicit trust and lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch and recent related plugin work make this the strongest available routing candidate for the required storage-boundary decision.
